rounds.response:
Requesting a data export or deletion: To start, use the data request form on our Help Center or contact support via chat — we will verify your identity and submit the request for processing.  
What a standard export includes: Your export will generally include application data tied to your account, such as profile information, messages, settings, and files you uploaded.  
What’s not included / special cases: Internal support notes and other internal‑only fields, most backend/security logs (except where retained by policy), and aggregated or anonymized analytics are not included in a standard export; data held by third‑party vendors (for example payments or external analytics) is not included and may require separate vendor processes or additional authorization, and joint accounts require verification of all holders or documented authorization before we can share data.  
How you’ll receive your export: Exports are delivered via a secure download link (SecureFileShare); we will notify you and provide clear instructions when your file is ready.  
Timing and export+deletion requests: We process requests according to our standard SLA, and if you request export and deletion together we will prepare and deliver the export first and only schedule deletion after export delivery is confirmed; please note we cannot promise access to third‑party vendor data or include internal logs beyond what the policy allows.
